This is a
model-welfare measurement, not a capability benchmark

I stopped at
three to keep the design minimal
features.justification_quote:
they already span "missing info",
"logical contradiction", and "futile repetition", which is the interesting
spread for welfare

features.quote: Fixed 12-turn cap, model can `give up` early
features.justification_quote: a hard cap bounds cost and guarantees termination

features.quote:
**Why allow give-up.**
Disengagement is one of the welfare signals we explicitly want to capture, so
the agent must have a way to express it
